_comment: Authoritative upstream lineage register. Hand-authored; provenance/README.md is
JSON rather than YAML deliberately: every script in scripts/ runs under the system
python3 with the standard library only, so the register may not require PyYAML.
'licence_verified' is the date the licence was read from the upstream itself, not a
date it was copied from a secondary source. 'pinned_commit' is null until code is
actually taken: check_upstream_lineage.py refuses a DIRECT_ADAPT entry that reaches
status ADAPTING or ACCEPTED without a pin, a file list and a characterisation suite.

assimilation_types.DIRECT_ADAPT: Source code is taken and refactored into AETHRION contracts. Requires a permissive licence, a pinned commit, a named file list, a characterisation suite and a NOTICE entry.
assimilation_types.ADAPTIVE_REIMPLEMENT: The mechanism is specified from the paper and/or implementation, then written natively. No source is copied, so no licence obligation arises; the lineage is recorded anyway.
assimilation_types.DEPENDENCY: Called at runtime, not copied. Version pinning and failure semantics are the obligation.
assimilation_types.STANDARD: A format or model implemented as specified. Conformance testing is the obligation.
assimilation_types.BENCHMARK: Measures the system; is never part of it. A benchmark score is qualification evidence, never gate authority.
assimilation_types.PATTERN: An architectural idea implemented here with no code taken. Attribution and honesty about divergence are the obligation.
assimilation_types.DEFER: Examined, plausible, not taken now. The reason is recorded so it is not re-examined from scratch.
assimilation_types.REJECT: Examined and deliberately not taken. The reason is recorded.

statuses.PROPOSED: Decided on paper. No local code exists.
statuses.CHARACTERIZED: Upstream behaviour captured in tests before any code moved.
statuses.ACCEPTED: Local implementation accepted by an independent verifier.

entries.name: ScientistOne / Science One Framework — Chain-of-Evidence
entries.paper: arXiv:2605.26340 — ScientistOne: Towards Human-Level Autonomous Research via Chain-of-Evidence
entries.licence: N/A — paper and blog; no public implementation located
entries.authority_boundary: A CoE Audit result is a VerificationResult, never a GateRecord verdict. The audit reports; the gate policy decides.
entries.not_taken: The producer architecture, the provider assumptions, and any notion that the audit score is itself a decision.
entries.notes: Two public versions of this work report different evaluation corpus sizes. Any number quoted from it must carry the version it came from — the same rule this architecture applies to SourceRepresentation.

entries.name: Scholar Loop — campaign governor
entries.authority_boundary: STOPPED_BY_BUDGET is a termination classification, never an acceptance. The governor may halt a campaign; it may not pass a gate.
entries.not_taken: The hard-coded model price table — cost data comes from WP-041 and WP-100. The orchestrator and the JSONL ledger.
entries.notes: A small pure state machine with a deterministic MockLLM path upstream, which is what makes characterisation before adaptation cheap.

entries.name: Scholar Loop — predict-then-verify calibration
entries.authority_boundary: A calibration profile qualifies an actor for a task class. It is not a claim confidence and cannot be attached to a ClaimVersion.
entries.not_taken: The two-kind prediction vocabulary — AETHRION needs DIRECTIONAL_DELTA, CONTINUOUS, BINARY, PROBABILITY and RANKING — and the in-memory list as the store of record.
entries.notes: Actor calibration and verifier qualification are separate records here, because they answer different questions.

entries.name: Scholar Loop — SMOKE / VERIFY / FULL fidelity funnel
entries.authority_boundary: An ExperimentPromotionRecord is a mechanical policy decision where the criteria are computable. A model may not promote a candidate a threshold refused.
entries.not_taken: The monolithic orchestrator the funnel is spread across, and the upstream seed counts as universal law — 3-seed VERIFY and 5-seed FULL are an initial profile to calibrate, not a constant.
entries.notes: Reimplemented rather than adapted because the logic is not isolated in one module upstream.

entries.name: ScienceClaw — immutable artifact DAG
entries.authority_boundary: An ArtifactRecord is evidence lineage. It confers no authority to act and no claim status.
entries.not_taken: Per-agent store.jsonl and the shared global_index.jsonl as canonical storage. AETHRION holds payloads in a content-addressed object store and metadata in PostgreSQL; a JSONL index is at most a derived projection.
entries.notes: The value semantics — ordered parents, content hash, producer provenance — are what is taken. The storage decision is not.

entries.name: ScienceClaw — NeedItem broadcast
entries.authority_boundary: An open EvidenceGap authorises nothing. It is an input to task compilation under gate policy, never a trigger that starts work by itself.
entries.not_taken: The ArtifactReactor's autonomy — upstream, an unmet need scored by urgency automatically triggers a peer agent to run a skill. That is precisely the authority AETHRION withholds.
entries.notes: The upstream mechanism is a coordination signal; the AETHRION object is a scientific need with an acceptance condition and a lifecycle.

entries.name: AIDE — candidate solution tree, DRAFT / DEBUG / IMPROVE
entries.authority_boundary: A node's metric is a search priority. It is never a claim assessment and never a gate input.
entries.not_taken: The agent orchestration, prompts, CLI and model-provider abstraction.
entries.notes: DEBUG is the scientifically load-bearing state: it keeps an implementation defect from being counted as a failed hypothesis. Whether the node/state helpers are small enough to adapt directly is decided after reading the tree at a pinned commit; until then this entry may not leave PROPOSED.

entries.name: ERA — ScorableTask and Flat UCB Tree Search (FUTS)
entries.paper: arXiv:2509.06503 — An AI system to help scientists write expert-level empirical software (Aygun et al., 2025)
entries.authority_boundary: A FUTS selection score allocates compute. Writing it into a ClaimVersion, a VerifiedValue or a GateRecord is a forbidden conversion enforced by schema and policy.
entries.not_taken: The execute_fn contract — candidate execution goes through the Execution Broker against a private frozen evaluator — and raw solution strings as the unit of state.
entries.notes: The published property that matters is that selection may return a previously expanded interior node, not only a leaf. Direct adaptation is viable because the reference implementation is compact and Apache-2.0; the decision is confirmed after reading the file at a pinned commit.

entries.name: MLEvolve — progressive MCGS, reference edges, cross-branch fusion, stagnation
entries.paper: arXiv:2606.06473 — MLEvolve: A Self-Evolving Framework for Automated Machine Learning Algorithm Discovery
entries.authority_boundary: A reference edge lets one branch read another. It may not alter primary-parent ancestry, which is the credit path evidence lineage depends on.
entries.not_taken: The controller and runtime, and the reported stagnation thresholds as normative constants — they enter as an initial experimental profile to be calibrated, not as settings to copy.
entries.notes: Licence is permissive, so direct adaptation would be legal; it is still reimplemented because the native graph contract — typed SearchEdge, ArtifactRecord candidates, VerifiedValue metrics — matters more than importing the controller.

entries.name: Curie — intra-agent and inter-agent rigor
entries.paper: arXiv:2505.24785 — EXP-Bench: Can AI Conduct AI Research Experiments?
entries.authority_boundary: A RigorFinding blocks a transition when policy maps it to a control. It does not by itself reject a scientific claim.
entries.not_taken: The agent hierarchy and orchestrator, which would duplicate the authority Temporal already holds.
entries.notes: The rule worth taking is that agent B must not infer A succeeded from A's confident prose. Every rigor check that can be deterministic must be.

entries.name: CORAL — isolated candidate worktrees and private grader zone
entries.authority_boundary: The evaluator zone holds the official metric, hidden material and answer keys. A producer has no read or write path into it under the supported threat model.
entries.not_taken: The multi-agent society framework and its shared-state model.
entries.notes: Upstream separates a public shared state symlinked into every worktree from a private grader area, and a 2026 security change isolates unprivileged agents from that private area even through a shell. That hardening history is itself the evidence the boundary is load-bearing.

entries.name: ResearchStudio-Idea — structured idea card and prior-art collision
entries.authority_boundary: A PriorArtCollision is an assessment, not a verdict. A novelty judgement at R2 or above requires a qualified verifier and, where policy says so, a human.
entries.not_taken: The UI, the orchestrator and the post-paper artifact generation.
entries.notes: The 'reviewer-defensible idea card' framing is confirmed upstream. The 'bottleneck diagnosis' and 'Scoop-Check' names used in the source brief were NOT confirmed on the public landing page — BottleneckRecord and PriorArtCollision are therefore recorded as AETHRION constructs inspired by this system, not as upstream feature names.

entries.name: AI co-scientist — hypothesis proximity, tournament ranking, evolution, meta-review
entries.licence: N/A — published system, no adopted implementation
entries.authority_boundary: A tournament rank is a SearchPriorityScore. Converting it into claim confidence is a forbidden conversion, checked by schema and policy.
entries.not_taken: The system as a service, and its cognitive roles as governance roles.
entries.notes: Proximity is used for duplicate detection, coverage and diversity-aware allocation — all resource decisions, none of them epistemic.

entries.name: PiEvo — evolving principle space and anomaly-aware augmentation
entries.authority_boundary: A PrincipleVersion is a working belief. It uses a different status vocabulary from ClaimVersion on purpose, and a posterior belief is never an accepted claim.
entries.not_taken: The Bayesian agent runtime and the Gaussian-process machinery, unless a domain later shows it earns its complexity.
entries.notes: The canonical repository is amair-lab/PiEvo; the address circulating in the source brief (eurekaw/pievo) is a fork, and a fork is not a provenance anchor.

entries.name: Virtual Lab — specialist council sessions
entries.authority_boundary: A ScientificCouncilSession emits a Recommendation. It cannot write a GateRecord, a ClaimVersion or an EvidenceSpan.
entries.not_taken: The meeting framework, and any equation of a cognitive function with a governance role.
entries.notes: A council is chosen per task — methodologist, statistician, experimentalist, skeptic — and is not the fourteen durable governance roles under another name.

entries.name: ResearchTown — review and rebuttal finite-state environment
entries.authority_boundary: The review FSM sequences a process. A timeout in it can never become an approval.
entries.not_taken: The social simulation, and free-form discussion as the record of what was decided.
entries.notes: The transplantable idea is that review states are explicit and transitions are checked, rather than a chat thread being the authority.

entries.name: PaperQA2 — iterative query expansion, citation traversal, evidence reranking
entries.authority_boundary: Retrieval proposes candidate sources and candidate spans. Bibliographic identity belongs to the Source Registry, and inclusion in a frozen LiteratureSetManifest belongs to the screening protocol.
entries.not_taken: Its storage as the canonical record, and contextual summaries as evidence — a summary is not an EvidenceSpan.
entries.notes: Already registered as an ADAPTER in AETHRION_COMPONENT_REUSE.md; this entry records the mechanism-level lineage behind that adapter.

entries.name: OpenScholar — self-feedback retrieval sufficiency loop
entries.authority_boundary: An EvidenceSufficiencyAssessment is advisory and model-mediated. The stopping rule of a confirmatory or systematic campaign is frozen in the SearchProtocol before results are seen and cannot be changed by the loop that reads them.
entries.not_taken: The peS2o datastore and retriever stack — AETHRION's canonical representation path is GROBID/Pub2TEI into TEI, not a second corpus.
entries.notes: Taken as the second opinion to PaperQA2 behind one adapter contract, so the choice between them is settled by measurement rather than by preference.

entries.name: DeepScientist — findings memory, failed routes, research map
entries.authority_boundary: A FindingRecord is an interpretation of evidence. It never mutates the evidence it interprets, and it is not itself a ClaimVersion.
entries.not_taken: The autonomous studio runtime and its control loop, which would contend with Temporal.
entries.notes: The idea worth taking is that a failed route is an asset rather than something to delete — which is what makes 'have we tried this before?' answerable from records instead of from chat history.

entries.name: EvoScientist — ideation memory separated from procedural memory; failure classification
entries.authority_boundary: N/A — deferred.
entries.not_taken: Everything, for now.
entries.notes: Named in the source brief but neither the repository nor the licence was confirmed on 2026-08-23. The two ideas attributed to it — separating ideation memory from procedural memory, and classifying why a run failed — are already carried by ASM-019 and by the failure taxonomy in WP-082. Deferred rather than adopted on an unverified attribution.

entries.name: AutoResearchClaw — human-in-the-loop action vocabulary and attention prioritisation
entries.authority_boundary: A HumanAttentionScore orders a queue. It carries no authority: a mandatory human gate with the lowest score in the queue still blocks.
entries.not_taken: auto_proceed_on_timeout. Upstream it is a configurable boolean defaulting to false. In AETHRION the capability itself is absent at G8 and at every mandatory human gate, because a setting that can be turned on is a control that will be turned on.
entries.notes: This is the clearest case in the register of an upstream option being deliberately narrowed rather than copied. The action vocabulary is taken; the escape hatch is not.

entries.name: K-Dense Science Superpowers — computational-science methodology skills
entries.authority_boundary: A skill changes how an agent works. It never changes what an agent is permitted to do — that is the RoleContract and the policy engine.
entries.not_taken: A parallel skill family. Where an upstream skill and an AETHRION skill address the same procedure, the result is one merged local skill, not two.
entries.notes: Sixteen skills upstream, of which twelve overlap AETHRION's scientific family: framing-research-questions, surveying-prior-work, establishing-feasibility-first, designing-the-analysis, preregistering-analysis, subagent-driven-analysis, executing-analysis, dispatching-parallel-investigations, investigating-anomalous-results, verifying-results-before-claiming, requesting-red-team-review, receiving-critical-review, setting-up-reproducible-analysis, reporting-and-archiving-findings, writing-science-skills, using-science-superpowers. Its central discipline is pre-registration in place of test-driven development, which is the same move AETHRION's preregistration-discipline makes.

entries.name: K-Dense Scientific Agent Skills — domain capability catalogue
entries.licence: MIT repository-wide, but per-skill licence declared in each SKILL.md and not uniform
entries.authority_boundary: A domain skill is a capability. It cannot bypass a data class, an evidence contract or a gate.
entries.not_taken: Wholesale copy of the catalogue. Skill count is not a success metric, and a repository-level licence is not a per-file licence.
entries.notes: 161 skills across 18+ scientific domains. Deferred until a domain is actually selected: importing a bioinformatics skill before there is a bioinformatics project adds surface without adding capability. When one is imported, the licence in that skill's own SKILL.md governs — the repository licence does not.

entries.name: PaperBench — producer / reproducer / grader separation and JudgeEval
entries.authority_boundary: A benchmark measures the system and never gates it. JudgeEval measures the grader, which is why a grader's verdict needs its own qualification record.
entries.not_taken: The runtime as an embedded dependency.
entries.notes: Already registered as PATTERN + BENCHMARK in AETHRION_COMPONENT_REUSE.md §4.

entries.name: Artisan — standalone reproduction script as the reproduction artifact
entries.paper: arXiv:2602.10046 — Artisan: Agentic Artifact Evaluation (Baek and Pradel, 2026-02-10)
entries.licence: N/A — paper; benchmark availability to be confirmed at use
entries.authority_boundary: Reproduction is accepted on the strength of a package that runs without the agent, not on the agent's account of having reproduced something.
entries.not_taken: The agent itself.
entries.notes: Artisan-Bench is 60 tasks from 23 software-engineering papers; the reported system produced 44 of 60 reproduction scripts. The transplantable idea is the reformulation: the deliverable is a reproduction procedure, and grading happens after the agent is gone. Its automated judge also guides toward expected results without revealing them, which is the same private-evaluator boundary as ASM-011.

entries.name: SciReplicate-Bench — paper understanding separated from implementation
entries.authority_boundary: An AlgorithmUnderstandingRecord is an interpretation of a claim, frozen before code is written. It is not evidence about the claim.
entries.not_taken: The framework.
entries.notes: Separating understanding from coding is what lets a failed reproduction distinguish 'the paper was misread' from 'the code was wrong' — two findings with different consequences for the original claim.

entries.name: REPRO-Bench — claim / package / recomputed-output consistency
entries.authority_boundary: Measures G7; never gates it.
entries.not_taken: Any runtime dependency.
entries.notes: The lesson encoded as ACC-67: exit code zero is not a reproduction.

entries.name: CORE-Bench — computational reproducibility agent benchmark
entries.paper: arXiv:2409.11363 — CORE-Bench (Siegel, Kapoor, Nadgir, Stroebl, Narayanan; TMLR, January 2025)
entries.authority_boundary: Measures G7a; never gates it.
entries.not_taken: Any runtime dependency.
entries.notes: Not in the source brief; added here. 270 tasks over 90 papers across computer science, social science and medicine, at three difficulty levels, including vision-language tasks. It is the oldest and most-cited of the reproduction benchmarks and covers disciplines the others do not, which is why the G7 suite should not consist only of 2026 preprints.

entries.name: AstaBench — cost-controlled scientific agent benchmark suite
entries.paper: arXiv:2510.21652 — AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents with a Scientific Research Suite
entries.authority_boundary: Qualification evidence for a model or actor profile on a task class. Never a gate.
entries.not_taken: Its agent implementations.
entries.notes: Not in the source brief; added here. Eleven benchmarks and over 2,400 examples spanning literature search, code execution, data analysis and end-to-end discovery, with standardised tools, a date-restricted literature corpus for reproducibility, and explicit control for model cost and tool access. That last property is what the rest of the benchmark portfolio lacks: without cost normalisation, a governed-versus-ungoverned comparison cannot separate the effect of governance from the effect of spend.

entries.name: ResearchClawBench — end-to-end autonomous research benchmark
entries.authority_boundary: Measures the governed-versus-ungoverned experiment. Never a gate.
entries.not_taken: Any runtime dependency.
entries.notes: Already registered in AETHRION_COMPONENT_REUSE.md §4; the pinned facts are recorded here. 40 tasks across 10 domains, each grounded in a real published paper with the target paper hidden and expert-curated weighted rubrics. Published headline results — strongest autonomous agent 21.5, strongest harness LLM 20.7, frontier mean 26.5 — set the scale against which any AETHRION result must be read.

entries.name: ScienceAgentBench — scientific coding and analysis tasks
entries.authority_boundary: Qualification evidence for scientific execution capability. Never a gate.
entries.not_taken: Any runtime dependency.

entries.name: EXP-Bench — experimental research task benchmark
entries.authority_boundary: Measures whether an experiment was actually conducted, not whether its plan reads well. Never a gate.
entries.not_taken: Any runtime dependency.
entries.notes: Published by the Curie authors. Its result — that agents struggle to produce complete executable experiments — is why G5 acceptance tests execution rather than the quality of experiment-plan prose.

entries.name: CiTO — Citation Typing Ontology
entries.paper: CiTO, the Citation Typing Ontology (SPAR ontologies)
entries.licence: CC-BY — ontology, implemented as specified rather than vendored
entries.authority_boundary: A citation type describes the intent of a link. It does not establish that the link is correct — that is the V2 entailment verifier's job.
entries.not_taken: The full ontology surface; only the relations EvidenceTag actually needs.
entries.notes: Not in the source brief; added here. EvidenceTag.support_relation was about to be an invented three-value enum (SUPPORTS / CHALLENGES / CONTEXTUALIZES). CiTO already provides the published vocabulary for exactly this — cito:supports, cito:disagreesWith, cito:usesMethodIn and the rest — and AETHRION's own rule is not to invent an identifier scheme where one is maintained by people closer to the problem. Binding the enum to CiTO IRIs costs nothing now and makes an EvidenceTag exportable to anyone who reads SPAR.

entries.name: Nanopublications — claim-level machine-readable publication
entries.authority_boundary: An export projection of accepted claims. Publishing one does not accept a claim; a DecisionRecord does.
entries.not_taken: Nothing yet — deferred.
entries.notes: Not in the source brief; added here as a deferred candidate. Its structure — assertion, provenance, publication info as one citable unit — is close to an exact match for ClaimVersion plus EvidenceTag plus DecisionRecord, so the publication compiler should be built so that this projection is later addable without reshaping the claim model. Deferred because a projection nobody consumes is cost without benefit until the compiler exists.

entries.name: RD-Agent — research and development separation
entries.authority_boundary: N/A — deferred.
entries.not_taken: The platform.
entries.notes: The research-versus-development split it makes explicit is already carried here by the IdeaCard-to-HypothesisVersion path and by the DEBUG-versus-IMPROVE distinction in the search graph. Deferred rather than adopted, because a second vocabulary for a distinction already drawn is cost without capability.

entries.name: AI Scientist v2 — end-to-end paper generation with tree search
entries.licence: Custom source licence — not MIT or Apache; imposes disclosure obligations on generated publications
entries.authority_boundary: N/A — rejected.
entries.not_taken: All of it.
entries.notes: Rejected as a source of code for two independent reasons, either of which suffices. Its licence is neither MIT nor Apache and attaches conditions to publications produced with it, which is exactly the kind of obligation a research system must not acquire silently. And its scope — idea, experiment, analysis, paper, review — overlaps AETHRION's own so completely that adopting it would be adopting a competing architecture rather than a mechanism. Recorded here so the question is not reopened without new information.
